name: Cerenovus
ability: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are “mad” they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.
interaction: Cerenovus chooses a player (alive or dead) and a Townsfolk/Outsider character. The chosen player is woken and shown 'This character selected you', the Cerenovus token and the chosen character.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned, the Storyteller may still wake the target and show the madness, but the madness has no effect: the player cannot be executed for breaking it.

jinxes.text: The Cerenovus may choose to make a player mad that they are the Goblin.

rulings.text: Madness requires a genuine effort to convince the group; the Storyteller judges.
A madness execution counts as the day's one execution (as with the Mutant); if during the day, go to night.
Evil players may be executed for breaking madness but the Storyteller may decline.
Dead players can be chosen and executed for breaking madness.

test_scenarios.name: mad and complies
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Ann Cerenovus, Bo Barber, Cy Vortox, Di Savant, Ed Clockmaker.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Ann chooses Bo as Savant. Day 1: Bo claims Savant consistently.
test_scenarios.expected: Bo is shown the madness; the Storyteller does not execute Bo.

test_scenarios.name: breaks madness
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Ann chooses Ed as Dreamer. Day 2: Ed openly says he is the Clockmaker.
test_scenarios.expected: The Storyteller may execute Ed; it is the day's execution and night falls.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned Cerenovus
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Ann Cerenovus, Fi Poisoner, Bo Barber, Cy Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Fi poisons Ann; Ann chooses Bo as Savant. Day 1: Bo says he is the Barber.
test_scenarios.expected: Bo is not executed for madness.

test_scenarios.name: Goblin jinx
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Ann Cerenovus, Bo Chef, Cy Imp; Goblin on the script.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Ann chooses Bo with the Goblin.
test_scenarios.expected: Allowed: Bo is mad about being the Goblin.
